question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Find the percentage of customers who have rented at least one film featuring any of the top 5 actors
-- Top 5 actors by number of films: actor_ids 107, 102, 198, 181, 23

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS customers_who_rented_top5_film,
    (1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
WHERE fa.actor_id IN (107, 102, 198, 181, 23)
